_status: TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER. These sizes and ratios are neutral placeholders, not taken from any standard or building code. Check them against the daylight and ventilation rules that apply to the project.
_doc: Automatic windows. glazingRatio: wanted window area as a share of the room's floor area (to wall centrelines); a room gets as many windows of its type's size as that needs, at least one, at most `max`. jambClearance: wall left between a window and a wall that joins the facade. pier: least wall between two windows. minWidth: a window may be narrowed down to this to fit a short facade. types: room types that get windows, with the window size for each; other room types get none.
